title: Accuracy and efficiency of compact foundation models for surface-water mapping during floods
abstract: arXiv:2610.34904v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pretrained Earth observation models may reduce the effort needed to map surface water, but their value depends on the alternative against which they are compared. We evaluated Prithvi-EO-2.0-Tiny using the 446 hand-labeled Sentinel-2 chips from 11 flood events in Sen1Floods11. A fine-tuned model, a frozen-encoder model, and an identical randomly initialized architecture were compared with a similarly sized U-Net, a larger Prithvi model, and spectral-index thresholds. Experiments varied the number of training chips, excluded events from model fitting, and measured computational cost and prediction reliability. With 252 training chips, U-Net achieved a water intersection-over-union (IoU) of 0.856 on the official test set, compared with 0.833 for fine-tuned Prithvi-Tiny. Pretraining improved the tiny transformer over random initialization by a reported 0.046 IoU with 25 training chips and 0.023 with 252 chips, but did not reverse the U-Ne

translated_title: 紧凑型基础模型在洪水期间地表水制图中的精度与效率
translated_abstract: 预训练的地球观测模型可能会减少地表水制图所需的工作量，但其价值取决于与之比较的替代方案。我们使用Sen1Floods11中11次洪水事件的446个手工标注的Sentinel-2图像块评估了Prithvi-EO-2.0-Tiny。研究将微调模型、冻结编码器模型和相同架构的随机初始化模型，与规模相近的U-Net、更大的Prithvi模型以及光谱指数阈值方法进行了比较。实验改变了训练图像块的数量，在模型拟合中排除了部分事件，并测量了计算成本和预测可靠性。在使用252个训练图像块时，U-Net在官方测试集上达到了0.856的水体交并比，而微调后的Prithvi-Tiny为0.833。预训练使该小型transformer相比随机初始化在使用25个训练图像块时IoU提高了0.046，使用252个图像块时提高了0.023，但仍未能扭转U-Net的优势。
tldr: 在Sen1Floods11洪水数据上的系统评估表明，小型预训练基础模型Prithvi-Tiny的地表水制图精度仍略低于同等规模的U-Net，预训练虽在小样本场景下带来一定提升，但不足以弥补这一差距。
en_tdlr: Systematic evaluation on Sen1Floods11 shows that the compact pretrained foundation model Prithvi-Tiny slightly underperforms a similarly sized U-Net for flood surface-water mapping, and although pretraining helps in low-data settings, it does not close the gap.
